newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sandoz hopes for U.S. Novartis ruling.
newsitem.headline: Sandoz hopes for U.S. Novartis ruling.

text.p: Sandoz AG said chief executive Daniel Vasella was still hopeful of U.S. regulatory approval before the end of the year for Sandoz's merger with Ciba-Geigy AG as pharma giant Novartis AG.

A Sandoz statement quoted Vasella, the designated chief executive of Novartis, who has said in the past the merger might be pushed back into 1997 because of a slower than expected review by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC).
"On the subject of the Novartis merger approval in the United States, Dr Vasella said that he was still hopeful of FTC clearance before the end of the year," Sandoz said.
Vasella was quoted in a statement announcing German antitrust approval for Sandoz to complete its purchase of generic drug maker Azupharma from Gehe AG.
The statement did not elaborate on Vasella's views on U.S. approval for the Novartis merger.
The merger of Sandoz and Ciba to form the world's second-biggest pharmaceutical group was approved by each company's shareholders in April and by the European Commission in July.
Both Sandoz and Ciba said in late October they expected the FTC to rule in late autumn on the Novartis deal.
